Yen.name: Yen
Yen.description: Japanese yen: coins from ¥1 to ¥500, notes from ¥1,000 to ¥10,000, and the stored balance on a phone wallet or IC card. Ticket gates, vending machines and convenience stores take a tap of card or phone; small shops, food stalls and shrines often want cash. An onigiri costs about ¥150, and part-time work pays about ¥1,100 an hour. [ Currency | Legal tender ]
